# Evaluation queries for medsearch.
#
# 100 queries, sized by a power calculation: the observed paired per-query
# recall difference has sd 0.308, so detecting a 0.088 effect at 80% power
# needs n = 97. The first evaluation used 30 and was underpowered.
#
# Phrased the way a clinical researcher would type them, deliberately NOT in
# the vocabulary the abstracts use -- testing paraphrase is the point.
# Topics span the corpus broadly; no query was chosen after seeing which
# method it favours.
#
# One query per line. Lines starting with # are ignored.

# --- original 30 (already labelled; retained for continuity) ---
lung failure
breathing difficulty

kidney injury

vaccine immunogenicity
antibody response after second dose
immunocompromised vaccine recipients
blood clots and anticoagulation
pulmonary embolism risk
cytokine storm treatment
steroid therapy for inflammation
antiviral drug early treatment
viral load reduction
long covid fatigue
loss of smell and taste
mental health of healthcare workers
anxiety during the pandemic
pregnancy outcomes
children and adolescents
elderly care home residents
diabetes as a risk factor
obesity and severe disease
rehabilitation after hospital discharge
telemedicine remote monitoring
convalescent plasma therapy
monoclonal antibody treatment
heart damage myocarditis
